tool.name: o3-mini
tool.summary: OpenAI's cost-efficient STEM, math, and coding reasoning model with selectable reasoning effort levels (low, medium, high) and function calling.
tool.architecture: Reinforcement learning-trained reasoning model optimized for coding and STEM.
tool.usage:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
response = client.chat.completions.create(
  model="o3-mini",
  reasoning_effort="medium",
  messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Design an optimal LRU cache in Rust."}]
)
tool.limitations: Text only (no image modality input); reasoning adds latency.
